title: DNS resolution failures
symptoms: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND api.internal. Temporary failure in name resolution. Many services suddenly cannot resolve hostnames while IP addresses still work.
root_cause: The DNS resolver (CoreDNS, systemd-resolved or upstream DNS) is down, overloaded or misconfigured.
impact: Any call by hostname fails: service-to-service traffic, database connections and external APIs.
fix_steps: Test from a host: dig api.internal and nslookup api.internal.
Check CoreDNS / resolver pods and logs; restart them if unhealthy.
prevention: Run multiple resolvers, cache DNS locally, and monitor resolution latency.
